findings.detail: C117 treats seven source-stated 25.00% fixed all-PIK coupons as data outliers even though each extracted rate matches the schedule.

rationale: Raw schedule table 5 rows 4-10 explicitly disclose seven distinct Twin Star instruments at 25.00% inc PIK, with 25.00% fixed coupon and all PIK. The observed pik_rate of 25.0 therefore matches the source for every flagged row. C117's generic greater-than-20% outlier threshold is the faulty check for these distressed all-PIK instruments, so the grouped flag is a false alarm rather than a data defect.
